text:
felix: Quick sync: spotting an out-of-memory drift on runtime 8.0 when serving quant-v4 models with batch_size >= 12 on T4 pools. Memory affordance reported by the scheduler is 4-6% higher than actual, causing host OOM kills under sustained load. Proposing a regional unpin in us-east-1 for 3h to mitigate while we patch.

deploybot: (bot) New change window scheduled: unpin-window-5012 at 2026-04-02T04:00Z. Use `/deploybot unpin` to start.

nora: Can you paste the quick repro and telemetry? Is it a runtime or driver interaction?

felix: Repro: `tests/oom/drift_repro --model quant-v4 --batch 16 --seq 2048 --gpu t4 --duration 15m` -> host OOMs in ~8-12m. Telemetry: allocator reports free_memory=6GB but kernel shows <5.6GB; discrepancy grows under mempressure. Crash IDs: oom-drift-501. Seems related to a new async allocator path introduced in 8.0.

sam: Ops suggestion: do a staged unpin to runtime=7.9.4 in us-east-1 for the quant-v4 pool only. Canary at 5%, smoke metrics for host OOMs and scheduling affordance mismatch.

izzy: Also: SDK compatibility note — sdk v8.1 changed buffer prefetching which increases transient GPU memory usage; mark sdk v8.1 as "caution" with runtime 8.0 for high-batch quant-v4. Recommend pinning SDK to 8.0.x for affected customers until we ship runtime patch.

felix: Runbook:
1) `/deploybot unpin runtime=8.0 target=quant-v4-pool region=us-east-1 actor=felix reason="oom-affordance-drift" window=unpin-window-5012`
2) canary 5% for 20m -> measure host_oom_count, allocator_free_mib_delta, p95 latency
3) ramp 25% -> 100% if host_oom_count == 0 and delta < 0.1GB
4) rollback path: `/deploybot pin runtime=8.0 region=us-east-1 reason="revert-after-oom" actor=<engineer>` and open immediate incident
5) update compatibility matrix & release notes with SDK callouts and mitigation commands

deploybot: (bot) Command queued: `/deploybot unpin runtime=8.0 target=quant-v4-pool region=us-east-1 actor=felix window=unpin-window-5012` - queued.

ops: Canary started: routing r-use-quant-501 -> runtime=7.9.4 at 5%. We'll run `tools/mem_check --samples=200 --compare=allocator` as gate.

sam: Observability (22m): canary allocator delta reduced from 0.48GB -> 0.06GB, host_oom_count -> 0. Green to 25%. No customer-facing errors so far.

izzy: Drafted advisory: "Runtime 8.0 memory-affordance drift with quant-v4 on smaller GPUs. Recommended temporary SDK pin: `pip install redwood-sdk==8.0.3` and decrease batch_size to <=8 for heavy longseq until runtime 8.0.1 lands." I'll attach to enterprise channel.

felix: Engineering action: open PR for 8.0.1 to remove the async allocator fast-path for small devices and add an affordance sanity-check at epoch boundaries. ETA ~24h. Will include a regression test in infra.

ops: Rolling to 100% pinned pool at 01:10 UTC after progressive validation. Anchor created anchor-5012-mem expiring in 12h. Audit audit-5012 recorded.

nora: Support: monitoring #support-enterprise for any reports; prepped rollback playbook if needed. Also adding a console banner for affected region/pools pointing to advisory.

sam: Note to release notes: mark sdk v8.1 as increased transient memory usage; add example mitigation snippet and the exact pin command for customers.

felix: Leaving anchor for 12h while 8.0.1 builds and passes canary infra tests. After 8.0.1 is validated we'll unpin and publish postmortem.

deploybot: (bot) Anchor anchor-5012-mem will expire at 2026-04-02T16:10Z unless extended. To extend: `/deploybot anchor extend anchor-5012-mem duration=12h`."
